editorial.headline: Motorcycle Parts Wholesale: Nationally Open, Blocked for PMA in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This wholesale activity is nationally open to full foreign ownership, but Bali’s permanent PMA moratorium blocks registration today.
editorial.body:
KBLI 46633 covers the wholesale trade of motorcycle parts and accessories. It is a focused trading activity: the record places the business squarely in the wholesale market for components and accessories connected to motorcycles. The category’s value lies in that clarity, giving a defined registration home to businesses whose activity is the wholesale trade of those goods.

Registration is open at every listed scale: Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar. That wide scale availability matters because the activity is not confined to one size of enterprise. A business may register this activity across the full stated range, from Mikro through Besar, subject to the distinct foreign-investment position that applies nationally and the separate position that applies in Bali.

Nationally, the PMA status is TERBUKA and the foreign-ownership ceiling is 100%. In plain terms, foreign ownership may reach 100% for this activity at the national level. The national position is therefore direct: the activity is open to PMA registration, with no foreign-equity cap below full ownership recorded here. That status is grounded in Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021.

Bali produces a materially different outcome. A foreign investor cannot register this activity in Bali today. At the Besar scale, every stated scope is assessed as Rendah or Menengah-Rendah risk, bringing the activity within Bali’s island-wide, permanent moratorium on PMA registration for Low and Medium-Low risk activities. The Bali status is BLOCCATO_CLASSE_RISCHIO, and the block is not a reduction of the national 100% ceiling; it is a bar on PMA registration in Bali under the provincial moratorium. For founders, the essential distinction is simple: national openness does not create a current PMA registration route for this activity in Bali.
